title: Grateful Dead Live at Pauley Pavilion - University of California on 1973-11-17

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard mix captures a smoking November 17 1973 show highlighted by a soaring Playing in the Band → Uncle John’s → Morning Dew palindrome.
ai_review.review: The SirMick‑transferred soundboard recording is crisp, balanced and utterly immersive, letting listeners hear every nuance of the 1973 performance.  The concert is praised for its high energy, tight playing and a standout sequence that weaves Playing in the Band, Uncle John’s Band and Morning Dew into a mesmerizing palindrome.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviews (except one placeholder) award five stars and rave about both the musical performance and the pristine board mix, indicating an exceptional show with excellent recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call the mix "epic", "crisp" and praise SirMick's transfer; no drop‑outs or balance issues mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows organically, featuring a celebrated palindrome of Playing > Uncle John’s > Morning Dew > Uncle John’s that showcases the band's improvisational peak.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's tone and overall performance are repeatedly praised, described as beautiful, majestic and a key part of why the show feels "smokin'."
